era: 2019 OpenAI research-lab site (s1-s5): white pages with an uppercase tracked nav About/Progress/Resources/Blog, the homepage on a pink-orange-cyan-purple gradient with white-framed release cards. No ChatGPT, API, products or log-in existed.

sources.shows: research-lab homepage: swirl logo, OpenAI wordmark, ABOUT/PROGRESS/RESOURCES/BLOG uppercase tracked nav on the right, full-bleed pink-orange-cyan-purple gradient, 'Our Work' mission line with LEARN MORE, 'Recent Releases' white-framed cards, VIEW PROGRESS; below: Charter, Join OpenAI / View open positions, footer About/Progress/Resources/Blog/Charter/Jobs/Press, Twitter and Facebook icons, newsletter sign-up
blog index: same header on white, 'Blog' heading, list rows with title, date, excerpt, thumbnail
about page: mission statement in a serif, gradient artwork
press screenshot of the 'GPT-2: 1.5B Release' post: logo, ABOUT/PROGRESS/RESOURCES/BLOG nav, hero art, date + minute read, title, body
press screenshot of the 'Safety Gym' post: same nav, image + title + summary, uppercase PAPER / SAFETY GYM buttons

evidence: the 2019 site (s1-s5) was a research lab site: nav About/Progress/Resources/Blog only, no products, ChatGPT, API, business, search, log-in or menus; footer only About/Progress/Resources/Blog/Charter/Jobs/Press with Twitter and Facebook
features.action: hidden (openai.js data-n19-later: nav items, dropdown toggles, footer links and columns, Stories / business / ChatGPT sections, chatgpt.com links; openai.css search)

features.match: ^(Main Navigation|header area|nav area|main area|section area|article area|footer area|content area|Recent news|Latest research|repeated .*|View all)$
features.note: page regions; Recent news and Latest research are the 2019 'Recent Releases' cards and Blog list; View all = VIEW PROGRESS / View Blog

features.match: ^(OpenAI Home|About|About Us|Progress|Research|Research Index|Research Overview|Blog|News|Our Charter|Charter|Careers|Jobs|Press|Privacy Policy|Terms of Use|Your privacy choices|Skip to main content|X|Twitter)$
features.note: nav (Research renamed Progress, Company renamed About, Blog link to /news restored by openai.js) and footer (About, Progress, Blog, Charter, Jobs=Careers; Privacy/Terms/privacy choices are the legal footer slot); X is the 2019 Twitter link
content: post titles, categories, dates and read times (2019 cards show date + minute read)
